scope: Live workstation. Group by the highest recorded ancestor below a Windows shell or service manager.
Identically named executable families combine. A missing or recycled parent creates a new root.
Private commit and machine commit are different counters. Per-process CPU and logical I/O deltas cover only identities present in consecutive samples. Hardware writes and energy are unmeasured.
A short observation does not measure per-day savings, equivalence of workflows or CAD smoothness.
